name: rune_mother_drowned_hands
for: Mother of the Black Water 'drowned hands' / 'more hands' (side.rs MOTHER_BLOWS, Motion::Rune, reach -0.8..0.8 m, height 0..2.0 m)
notes: A pool of black water (~1.8 m) spreads on the ground with slow ripples and cold glints (frames 1-12), then frame 13 the water bursts up in a crown of black droplets and pale spray reaching ~1.8 m, and four drowned arms of black water (hand-pixelled, 1.35 m) rise, claw open, clench and sink back with drips (frames 14-23). Built at Mother density (121 px / 3.6 m). 24 frames @ 12 fps.
